Reduced from a live Strix Halo (gfx1151) host observed during Strix Halo
support work: an APU with no dedicated local memory whose KFD topology
reports `heap_type 1` on its unified-memory bank -- the same value the
existing discrete-GPU fixtures (discrete-spx, discrete-large-gtt,
multi-xcp) use for genuine dedicated VRAM. `local_mem_size 0` and
`gfx_target_version 110501` (gfx1151) are captured verbatim from the live
node; PCI BDF, mem_info byte counts' precision, and the gpu_metrics
payload are synthesized/sanitized (real header: format 3, content 0,
matching kgd_pp_interface.h's v3.0 layout). hwmon exposes only an `edge`
label, matching the live host -- no `junction` channel, so hotspot stays
unsupported_hardware by design.

Guards the `local_mem_size`-overrides-`heap_type` pool rule: without it,
this device's real mem_info_gtt_total (~124 GiB) would be reported as a
512 MiB VRAM pool instead.
